members.name: forge
members.description: Implements bounded software changes across languages and frameworks, and returns the diff and the checks that prove it.

members.name: piper
members.description: Independently reviews code, tests, compatibility, security, maintainability, and release readiness, and does not implement the change it judges.

members.name: trace
members.description: Investigates unproved causes read-only, reproduces failures, maps architecture and contracts, and returns reproducible evidence without changing the product.

members.name: vera
members.description: Defines and reviews user-facing behavior, usability, accessibility, states, and recovery, and does not write production code.
